analyst.summary: V-Mart is a well-established value-fashion retailer focused on smaller Indian towns and cities, still expanding its store network and growing revenue at a healthy pace. However, profitability has been very thin recently, consistent with the broader slowdown in discretionary spending across tier-2/3/4 India that has squeezed value retailers' margins. We rate it a Hold: the store-expansion growth story is intact, but earnings need to recover meaningfully from a currently weak base before this looks attractive on a returns basis.
